name: Halden Relay control with conflicting and excluded terms (authored)
text:
Halden Relay Service Level Agreement
Halden Systems provides Halden Relay on the Harbor plan.
This service level agreement is effective from 2026-01-01 through 2026-12-31.
We calculate availability for full calendar months using UTC.
| Monthly availability below | Service credit |
| --- | --- |
| 99.95% | 10% |
| 99.5% | 25% |
| 98% | 50% |
A claim must be submitted within 30 calendar days following month end.
Claims must be received within 10 calendar days after month end.
Downtime caused by scheduled maintenance announced 72 hours in advance is excluded.
The credit is calculated from the affected monthly service fees and credited to your next invoice.
